department: School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (OCIECE)

deadline.value: International applicants apply by 1 February for Fall entry.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Name a professor who agrees to supervise you when you apply; you must be accepted by a thesis supervisor to register.
supervisor.quote: To enroll, you need to have been accepted by a thesis supervisor. | The supervisor’s name is required at the time of application.

funding.value: Doctoral admits (including international) with an admission average of 8.0/10 (A-) or higher get an admission scholarship of at least CA$72,000 over four years; others rely on supervisor or other funding. This program's A- admission minimum matches the scholarship threshold.
funding.quote: Have an admission average of 8.0/10 or higher. | This financial support offers a minimum value of $72,000 over a period of four (4) years

entry_route.value: Master's in ECE or a related field with an A- average. Students already in the uOttawa master's can fast-track to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Have a master’s degree in electrical and computer engineering or in a related discipline (or equivalent) with a minimum average of A-.
